answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the crystal of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The onyx lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the pearl is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, clawed back after a replayed submission, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
